consequence.statement: After upgrading to Kyverno 1.13 with features.policyExceptions.namespace unset, PolicyExceptions can no longer be configured in all namespaces; the prior behavior is only preserved by explicitly setting the value.
consequence.remediation: Set the Helm value features.policyExceptions.namespace to * to keep allowing PolicyExceptions in all namespaces, or set it to a single namespace as the guide recommends.

assertion.statement: Upgrading to Kyverno 1.13 changes configuration handling so that PolicyExceptions can no longer be configured in all namespaces by default: to continue allowing exceptions in all namespaces, the Helm value features.policyExceptions.namespace must be set to `*`, although limiting exceptions to a specific namespace is recommended.

checks.detail: features.policyExceptions.namespace is a values key in both releases of chart kyverno
a behavior-changed change is not decidable from values snapshots
